question: May one low-risk model `allow-once` verdict authorize multiple byte-identical gateway executions during a reviewer instance?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes a single-use authorization outcome into a reusable one, and source/tests cannot determine whether that security contract is product-approved.

options.title: Preserve single-use authorization
options.body: Keep a fresh reviewer decision for every unmatched execution and pursue cost reduction without reusing an authorization verdict.

options.title: Define bounded reusable approval
options.body: Introduce an explicitly named reusable verdict with documented lifetime, invalidation, audit behavior, and focused security tests.

recommendation.title: Preserve single-use authorization
recommendation.body: Keep a fresh reviewer decision for every unmatched execution and pursue cost reduction without reusing an authorization verdict.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core exec authorization-policy choice requiring repository-level security and product ownership.
